desc: Leonard and Sheldon walk into an doctor's office with maroon upholstered chairs and Sheldon shuts the door behind him.
Leonard walks over to the nurse's desk and leans over to see what she's reading.
The doctor at the desk hands Leonard a clipboard and pen, then gets back to reading a paper.
Sheldon and Leonard are sitting in the waiting room with clipboards as Leonard adjusts his glasses.
Sheldon and Leonard stand up from maroon upholstered chairs and walk to the door to leave.
Leonard walks up the stairs holding a brown bag and talking to Sheldon, who is wearing plaid pants, walking by water jugs near the doors.
Penny catches Leonard and Sheldon staring at her from the hallway.
Penny, in a blue shirt, walks across the room to her opened door where Leonard and Sheldon stand.
Sheldon takes his keys out of the pocket of his plaid pants and unlocks the front door to his apartment.
Leonard and Sheldon enter their apartment, continuing their conversation, then Sheldon waves his finger.
Leonard knocks on an apartment door, with an ironing board leaning against the wall by the door, while Sheldon stands behind him.
Leonard holds up a paper bag while talking to Penny, who is wearing a blue shirt.
Penny in a blue shirt walks over to a white board with equations on it.
Leonard nervously bites his fingers, looking to the side, standing behind Sheldon in a plaid pants.
Sheldon in a plaid pants, walks over to his desk and spins around completely.
Penny in blue shirt, put her hand on the sofa near Sheldon.
Leonard in green hoodie and brown jacket, is sitting in the armchair while shaking his head and looking up.
Leonard puts his hand on his mouth and shake his head as he sits in the armchair.
Penny in blue shirt, puts her hands in her face and starts to cry.
Sheldon in plaid pants, slides to his spot on the couch after Penny gets up.
Penny in blue shirt, stands in the kitchen and takes a paper towel, while Leonard from armchair leans over to Sheldon.
Penny, holding a paper towel, adjusts her bangs and wipes a tear from under her eye.
Leonard joins Sheldon in the kitchen while Sheldon grabs a couple of orange bottles from the fridge.
Sheldon in plaid pants, open two bottles on the kitchen island.
Leonard and Sheldon grab bottles from the kitchen island, then Sheldon sits on the couch while Leonard leans against the wall, still talking.
Leonard walks to the door, lets in Howard holding a CD and Raj, who is wearing a red hat.
Howard, in a red shirt, raises his hand then quickly moves his middle finger up and down on his lips.
Sheldon, in a plaid pants, hands Raj, who is wearing a red hat, a bottle of water.
Penny runs out of the bathroom into the living room, where Raj, Howard, Leonard and Sheldon are, wearing only a purple towel.
Penny pulls back the shower curtain and climbs inside of the shower.
Howard walks into the living room carrying two juice boxes with straws.
Leonard grabs Sheldon, who is wearing a plaid pants, by the arm as he tries to walk away from the entrance to the building.
Leonard shakes the doors to the apartment building with both hands.
Two little girls with a clipboard and a box pass Sheldon and Leonard and enter the building.
Sheldon and Leonard exit the apartment building wearing underwear.
Leonard puts his hands inside his jacket pockets, while walking away from building, next to Sheldon wearing underwear.
Leonard and Sheldon enter the apartment in their underwear.
Penny hugs Leonard and Sheldon in their underwear.
Penny sits in the back seat and shrugs her shoulders twice as they all drive in a car.
